method: First-pass public-web evidence review, before running daily predictions. Date-specific and month/area searches; source leads opened for accepted labels. Not an exhaustive census. Search scope fields describe the investigated dates, not literal search transcripts.
acceptance: Credible original reporting with attributable local observations, or independent corroboration. Named-area daily evaluation only; no claim of flooding at the weather point.
non_flood_review: Searched for explicit no-flood/monitored dry-day evidence in Lekki and Ikosi-Ketu, 2024–2025. No full-day area-matched negative observations verified. Unresolved records are not negatives.

july-cable.finding: Contemporaneous reporting identifies Lekki among locations flooded on July 3.
july-cable.excerpt: Some residents woke up to find their homes and estates flooded.

july-punch-lekki.finding: Reporter visited Lekki Phase II on Wednesday evening. The article incorrectly calls July 4 a Wednesday; contemporaneous July 3 reporting resolves the storm date.
july-punch-lekki.excerpt: our correspondent visited a popular estate in the Lekki Phase II area on Wednesday evening

july-punch-ketu.finding: Original interviews identify an Ikosi-Ketu flood casualty on Wednesday, July 3. Exact flood onset is not established.
july-punch-ketu.excerpt: on Wednesday in the Ikosi area of Ketu in Lagos

july-pulse.finding: Contemporaneous secondary report places the incident on Taiwo Street, Ikosi-Ketu, on July 3. Its underlying reporting is credited to Daily Trust.
july-pulse.excerpt: on Taiwo Street in Ikosi, Ketu, Lagos

aug-channels.finding: Reports flooding in Lekki on Monday, August 4 following rainfall beginning Sunday night. Flood presence is supported; exact onset is unknown.

aug-guardian.finding: Official account confirms Monday flooding affected the Agungi corridor of Lekki. Used to corroborate location and day.
aug-guardian.excerpt: areas around the Agungi corridor of Lekki

sept-punch.finding: Reporter received a resident video and interviewed a resident in Osapa London, Lekki. The event was Tuesday, September 16, not the publication date.
sept-punch.excerpt: In a video sent to our correspondent by a resident of Osapa London in the Lekki area

sept-cable.finding: Reports flooding across September 23 and 24, including Lekki Phase 1. The first onset day is not securely isolated across the named places.

sept-radio.finding: Reports Wednesday flooding and official comment about Kusenla, Lekki. Retained with the September 23–24 episode rather than counting another independent storm.

may-guardian.finding: Identifies Saturday May 17 rainfall flooding in Lekki. A second independently sourced local account was not established during this review.
may-guardian.excerpt: particularly in Lekki, Ikoyi, and Lagos Island

oct-nema.finding: Official assessment concerns dam release and river water; do not score it as a new rainfall-only flash flood. Onset dates are not resolved.
oct-nema.excerpt: Communities impacted are Kara, Ikosi ketu

june-video.finding: First-person description names Chisco Bus Stop in Lekki but calls June 24 a Tuesday; June 24 was Monday. Retain unresolved date.

june-lady.finding: Reports a social video in Lekki without establishing when the incident occurred. Publication date is not an event date.
